response.original_title: Moacir Santos: O Maestro e Sua Genialidade
response.overview: This documentary chronicles the life and legacy of the brilliant Brazilian composer, musician, and maestro Moacir Santos. Best known for his monumental 1965 album Coisas, Santos was a foundational force in Brazilian music who mentored key figures of the bossa nova movement and earned deep respect from international jazz legends. Produced to honor his centennial, the film explores his musical genius and traces his journey from rural Pernambuco to Hollywood, cementing his status alongside icons like Tom Jobim and Villa-Lobos.
response.title: Moacir Santos: The Maestro and His Genius
